d: As India hosts Asia’s largest multilateral air exercise, Tarang Shakti, with 40 nations and advanced fighter jets including the US F-35, Saudi Arabia activates its Mecca Joint Defence Agreement amid escalating Houthi attacks. As Türkiye weighs military support and Pakistan reaffirms close ties with Riyadh, will Islamabad honour the pact if the conflict escalates? Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more.
